Liberation - Melovee

Started writing ‣

WritingView full archive ↗

Started writing @February 18, 2021

Unnamed

I wake up in the morning, to another day

My heart keeps beating

My eyes are opening

Thinking through the day ahead of me

My mind

starts

racing

Call it fate call it karma

There’s something bigger happening here

pushing me,

driving me forward

pushing me, driving me forward

Promise I choose to be greater

Harvest the fruits of my labor

Until I make it in the eyes of those I cater to

Harvest the fruits of my labor

Promise I chose to be greater

Not backing down this is a liberation

I get ready to head out, it’s been another great night

Desire hangs in the air

I don’t want to part ways

For reasons unknown

I can’t seem to express

What my heart is dying to say
